items.event_time_ist: Oct 11, 2026 (individual incident times unknown; warnings issued Oct 11-12)
items.summary: UKMTO warnings 164-26 through 169-26 now document SIX commercial vessels struck on Sunday, Oct 11 — five tankers (an outbound tanker, an outbound crude tanker, an outbound product tanker, plus the MT Petro Dolphin UAV strike near Sohar anchorage, Oman) and one inbound container ship — the highest single-day total since the war began. Four of the reports were time-late, meaning official incident counts had been undercounting the wave. The warning-164 tanker suffered steering-gear-room and port-water-tank damage and proceeded to Fujairah; the Sohar tanker was first classified as suspicious activity before UKMTO upgraded it to a UAV attack, with local authorities evacuating the crew. Splash247 adds UKMTO has now logged at least 18 reported attacks region-wide this month. This materially upgrades the three-vessel Oct 11 count reported overnight.
items.title: UKMTO: six vessels struck Oct 11 (five tankers + a container ship) — highest single-day total of the war
